note: Generated by clients/clientkeys/scripts/ua-portable-vectors.mjs (src/ua.js, @noble/curves 2.4.0, @noble/post-quantum 0.7.1); never edit by hand. UA-8 portable registrations: every digest is keccak256 of 32-byte words, no chain and no registry. Digests: pqzKeyHash = keccak256(PQZ_KEY_GROUP | pqzKey) (keyHash of scheme 0x0142, not a plain keccak; the key is of a set's length, else UAKeyData); pqzPopHash = keccak256(pqzPop); kemRecordHash = kemRecordDigest of the initial record; portablePopDigest = keccak256(PURPOSE_POP_V2 | ua | pqzKeyHash | kemRecordHash); registrationDigest = keccak256(portablePopDigest | attrs.pqzPopHash); popMessage = ua_msg(kind, PURPOSE_POP_V2, registrationDigest); pqzRegMessage = ua_msg(0x0142, PURPOSE_POP_V2, portablePopDigest) (the R_REG message); kemRecordDigest = keccak256(KEM_RECORD_TAG | ua | uint256(version) | keccak256(kemPk)), signed as ua_msg(kind, PURPOSE_KEM, kemRecordDigest); PQZ key record (setPqzKey): pqzKeyDigest = keccak256(PQZ_KEY_RECORD_TAG | ua | pqzKeyHash) (its R_REG message: ua_msg(0x0142, PURPOSE_PQZ_KEY, pqzKeyDigest)), recordDigest = keccak256(pqzKeyDigest | pqzPopHash), signed as ua_msg(kind, PURPOSE_PQZ_KEY, recordDigest). Absent attributes are empty / 0. PQZ key: set once per chain, by register or later by setPqzKey(ua, pqzKey, pqzPopHash, sig), which is accepted only while the registration has no PQZ key (UAPqzKeySet otherwise; holder rules as register). Client rule: one PQZ key per UA, ever (a UA that signs records for two PQZ keys can end with different keys on different chains). msig: members sign memberDigest = keccak256(ua | message) of the portable message (popMessage, the KEM record message, the PQZ key record message): a derived member under member, with empty key data for stored kinds. A native member: personal_sign only for PURPOSE_POP_V2, PURPOSE_KEM and PURPOSE_PQZ_KEY, and only a code-less EOA: EIP-191 keccak256("\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n32" | memberDigest), 65-byte r | s | v, low-s, v in {27, 28}, empty key data. Every other purpose stays UAAuth (EIP-712, never personal_sign: CTR-MTX-14). A member with code (an EIP-7702 delegate or a contract wallet) is checked by ERC-1271 isValidSignature(memberDigest, sig) on each chain: portable only where that wallet exists with the same behaviour. Rows: registrations[i] = register(kind, keyData, attrs, pop, pqzPop); kemRecords[i] = setKemKey(ua, version, kemPk, sig) (id = name/vN; v1 is also the registration's initial record); pqzKeyRecords[i] = setPqzKey(ua, pqzKey, pqzPopHash, sig) for a UA registered without a PQZ key (its proof bytes for storePqzPop: the set's filler, registrations "mldsa65/<set>".pqzPop). pqzPop rows are filler of a real R_REG proof's length per set, not proofs. negatives: mutation.row names a row of registrations (entry register, storePqzPop, requireAuthorized), kemRecords by id (setKemKey) or pqzKeyRecords (setPqzKey); mutation.set replaces fields (attrs.<field>, pqzPop, pop, ua, sig, pqzPopHash, purposeTag, digest, auth); mutation.registerWith gives the register call that precedes a storePqzPop row. Attribute checks run before the PoP; error is the registry's. A proof hash of keccak256("") (an empty proof) is UAPqzPopHash wherever a proof hash is signed, and storePqzPop refuses empty proof bytes.
